raw_snippet: Agentforce ARR exceeded $1.5 billion, up over 240% Y/Y.
note: Salesforce 8-K Ex. 99.1, 26 Aug 2026 (fiscal Q2 FY27, quarter to 31 Jul 2026). A floor ("exceeded"). New definition: from Q2 FY27 Agentforce ARR also counts Slackbot and Headless 360, so it is not comparable with earlier quarters.
